stages.headline: When lines a and b are cut by a transversal c, 8 angles appear; pairs are called alternate, corresponding and co-interior.
stages.headlineEnglish: When lines a and b are cut by a transversal c, 8 angles appear; pairs are called alternate, corresponding and co-interior.

stages.headline: Test 1: if alternate angles are equal, the lines are parallel.
stages.headlineEnglish: Test 1: if alternate angles are equal, the lines are parallel.

stages.headline: Tests 2 and 3: equal corresponding angles, or co-interior angles summing to 180°, mean the lines are parallel.
stages.headlineEnglish: Tests 2 and 3: equal corresponding angles, or co-interior angles summing to 180°, mean the lines are parallel.

stages.headline: When are lines a and b parallel?
stages.headlineEnglish: When are lines a and b parallel?
